recent.text: Incredibly impressive win for the Sixers, who end Miami's seven-game winning streak with no Joel Embiid + very little Jaylen Brown. Cannot say enough about how dominant the duo of Tyrese Maxey and LeBron James was. Great VJ Edgecombe and Dominick Barlow games, too. Story to come! https://t.co/sgE30bWE1L

recent.text: James with 25 points, 10 rebounds, 12 assists and one steal. He also has game-best plus-14 as the Sixers win 111-104.

recent.text: Triple-double alert: James has 21 points, 11 assists and seven rebounds with 10:23 remaining and the Sixers up 98-84.
recent.author: Keith Pompey

recent.text: Tasked with leading the Sixers without Tyrese Maxey to begin the fourth quarter, LeBron James rattled off back-to-back-to-back assists – first setting up two Anfernee Simons threes, then throwing a gorgeous alley-oop to VJ Edgecombe. Unbelievable LeBron game. Sixers lead by 14.
recent.author: Adam Aaronson

recent.text: After three: Heat 81, Sixers 90. Tyrese Maxey got going again in the third quarter – will the fourth belong to LeBron James? Those two have carried the Sixers all night, countering every blow from Giannis Antetokounmpo. Should be a fun finish here.
recent.author: Adam Aaronson

recent.text: Bona played six minutes as a reserve centered He had three rebounds, three fouls and a block.

recent.quoted_text: Walker and Barlow are giving the Sixers a solid one-two punch at the center position. Walker has seven points on 3-for-3 shooting with two rebounds and a steal. Barlow has seven points on 3-for-5 shooting with five rebounds off the bench.
